resources.string: Run the phone from the charger and stop charging the battery. The firmware only holds the battery at 80% or above.
Charging: %1$d mA into the battery · %2$s W
Discharging: %1$d mA out of the battery · %2$s W
Bypass is on. Connect a charger to run the phone from it.
Bypass is working: the phone runs from the charger and the battery is idle.
Charging to 80% first; bypass then holds the battery.
Bypass is on but the battery is still charging above 80%. Bypass is not taking effect.
The phone draws more than the charger supplies; the battery covers the difference.
The Turnip driver is not installed in this build

Turnip replaces the Vulkan driver for the whole system, including the UI renderer, not only for games. If the screen does not draw after the restart, switch back over adb:

adb shell setprop persist.sys.neo.gpu adreno
adb reboot
The graphics driver changes on the next restart.
Enforcing. Changes apply at once and persist across reboots.
Permissive. Changes apply at once and persist across reboots.

Permissive mode disables Android\'s security policy. Apps and services are no longer confined, so a compromised app can access data and hardware it normally cannot. This setting stays on across reboots until you turn enforcing back on.
Map the pop-up triggers to touches on the screen
While a trigger is popped up, pressing it touches its point on the screen. Holding the trigger holds the touch.
Drag L and R onto the screen. In a game, tap the floating trigger button or the Trigger points tile to place them right over the game.
A small trigger button floats over apps while mapping is on. Tap it in a game to place L and R over the game; drag to move it, long-press to hide it.
Open the editor when a trigger is unlocked

Pushing a shoulder trigger up from its locked position opens the touch point editor over the running game, so L and R can be moved on the fly without the floating button. Pushing the trigger back down closes it again unless you saved. Needs trigger touch mapping on.

A tick when a point is picked up, every few millimetres while it moves, a firmer click when it crosses the middle of the screen, and a confirmation on Save. Works even if touch vibration is off in system settings.
Trigger button hidden. Use the Trigger points tile, or switch mapping off and on, to show it again.
%1$s%% from the left, %2$s%% from the top (portrait)
Points stay on the same spot of the screen in every rotation. Retracting a trigger lifts its touch.
Drag L and R onto the buttons the triggers should press, then Save.
Effect, colour and brightness of the lights around the cameras
Off plays the effect in its stock colours
Breathe in Neo blue until Android has started
Priority: calls, then notifications, then low battery, then charging. Anything else shows the effect above.
Vibration strength and a feel test for the motor
Scales every vibration of the motor, in percent. Above 100 % the short effects get stronger; the long steady buzz is capped at full strength. Android\'s own intensity settings still apply on top.
Taps, gestures and the system feedback of apps
The rows above play through the normal vibration service, exactly as an app would trigger them. The switches are the same settings as in Settings > Sound & vibration.
Share the logs of the random shutdown and battery percentage problem
Builds one zip with everything the system recorded, then opens the share sheet. Takes one to three minutes. Use it right after the problem happened.
Collecting, please wait. Keep the phone awake.
Ready (%1$s). Choose where to send it.

The system keeps its logs, kernel log included, on disk across restarts, and the recorder writes the battery, charger and suspend state into them every 10 seconds. Quiet does not ask the battery chip anything, Active also reads the gauge and charger values. Switch to Active only when asked to; it can change how the chip behaves.
Double the frame rate of videos with motion interpolation on the DSP
Inserts an interpolated frame between every two video frames (30 → 60 fps, 60 → 120 fps) in the apps below. Applies to the next video an app opens. DRM-protected video is not changed.
For a few seconds after the screen turns off
Switch the panel to its flat, color-accurate calibration instead of the vivid default
Swipe down with three fingers to take a screenshot
Banking and other apps that refuse to run with developer options or USB debugging on see them as off

The apps turned on below see developer options, USB debugging and wireless debugging as off. Everything stays on for you and for every other app. An app is closed when you change it here, so it picks up the change when you open it again.
Apps that check other signs (root, an unlocked bootloader, system properties) may still notice.
Present a certified device to Google Play Integrity
Only Google\'s integrity checker sees the loaded device; every other app sees this phone
None. Update or import a pif.json.
Download the device profile the Neo maintainers keep working
Load a profile from a file
Not a valid pif.json (it needs at least FINGERPRINT)
Loaded. Play Integrity uses it from the next check.

Google bans fingerprints after a while; update when checks start failing. This can pass basic integrity. Device and strong integrity need a locked bootloader\'s hardware attestation, which no profile can provide.
Let Google apps enable their Pixel-only features (Gboard voice typing, Gemini, wallpapers)
The apps below see a Pixel 10 Pro XL. Only those apps are changed; the rest of the system keeps this phone\'s identity.
Changed apps are closed so they pick it up when opened again. Features that need Pixel hardware (Tensor, Gemini Nano) may still not work.
Theme styles, custom colours and fine tuning
Percent of the wallpaper colour strength used for accents; 100 is stock
How strongly backgrounds and surfaces pick up the accent; 100 is stock
Rotate the accent colours, in degrees
Tonal spot style, wallpaper colours, automatic palettes and stock tuning
Android\'s default. Calm, muted accents taken from the seed colour, with softly tinted backgrounds. Easy on the eyes and works with any wallpaper.
Almost greyscale: the seed colour is only a faint hint in accents and backgrounds. Clean, quiet and professional.
Strong, saturated accents from the seed colour, with secondary and tertiary colours shifted to neighbouring hues for variety. Bold and energetic.
Playful and unexpected: the main accent is rotated away from the seed colour, so the theme uses colours that are not in your wallpaper at all.
Colourful accents with pure grey backgrounds. The accent colours stand out sharply because nothing behind them is tinted.
A mix of fruity, neighbouring hues: primary and secondary are shifted about 50° from the seed colour and the seed colour itself becomes the tertiary accent. Cheerful and varied.
Stays faithful to the seed colour: the main accent is the exact colour (same strength), and backgrounds carry a little of it. Best when you pick a colour you want to see as-is.
Black, white and greys only; no colour anywhere. Individual colours picked below still apply on top.
Monet picks the seed colour from your wallpaper and changes it with every new wallpaper
Use a colour you choose as the seed, whatever the wallpaper
From the wallpaper. Tap to choose your own
The theme style builds five palettes from the seed colour. Pick a colour for any of them to replace that palette completely; the others keep following the style.
The main accent: switches, sliders, the active Quick Settings tiles, buttons and highlights
Quieter accents: chips, tonal buttons, inactive tiles, selected list items and the notification shade
The contrasting accent: badges, highlights and decorative details that should stand apart from the primary colour
Backgrounds and surfaces: app backgrounds, cards, dialogs, the lock screen and launcher surfaces
Outlines, dividers, secondary surfaces and the tint of secondary text and icons
Keep the CPU responsive while a game or Wine/Proton app is in front

While one of the apps below is in front, the CPU cannot drop below the chosen level for it. Games built on Wine/Proton keep handing work between threads; the scheduler sees each thread waiting and lowers the clock, which makes every hand-off slower. Applies only while the game is in front.
Raise the CPU floor while a chosen app is in front
